title.note: Game title kept byte-identical (glossary: keep); no Spanish title given.

hud.cast.note: Infinitive button, as Roblox's Spanish buttons; fishing sense (lanzar la línea).

hud.reel.note: Recoger (el sedal) = reel in; same verb as the pass name Autorrecogida. Avoided jalar (slang in some countries).

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0 and 1 read right. Carnada is the everyday Latin American word for fishing bait; cebo leans Spain.

catch.success.note: Guide pattern for inserted names: captura as the head noun and the tag in parentheses, so nothing has to agree with an unseen fish name (Carpa dorada (Raro)). 'You caught' folded into Nueva captura.

catch.new_record.note: kg kept; {weight} arrives with a decimal point, which Mexico also uses.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Invented name: farol (lantern) keeps the glowing-lantern idea. Linterna reads as flashlight in Latin America; Anguila linterna (16) is the alternative, by analogy with pez linterna.

rarity.mythic.note: Standalone tier tag in the masculine, as the guide sets for rarity tags (Legendario, Mítico); reads as above Legendario.

shop.rods.note: Short for cañas de pescar; clear inside a fishing shop and fits the tab.

shop.equipped.note: Feminine to agree with the rod it labels (la caña). En uso would be a gender-free alternative.

pass.auto_reel.note: auto- + recogida, same verb as hud.reel (Recoger). Recogida automática (19) is clearer but over the 14 budget. Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: ¡La Carnada de la suerte duplica tus probabilidades de atrapar peces raros!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Spanish needs the article before the subject; it sits outside <b> so only the pass name is bold. Duplica tus probabilidades is the natural idiom for 'doubles your chance'; raros matches the Raro tier.

sell.done.note: Count and coins can be 1, so label forms instead of '{count} peces por {coins} monedas' (1 peces, 1 monedas). The + marks the coins as earned.

sell.prompt.note: 22 chars, 1 over the estimated 21; Presiona is the Latin American norm for keys (guide reference: Presiona E para abrir). If the prompt clips, use Pulsa E para vender (19).

ascend.button.note: Prestige sense of ascender (move up a rank), not religious and not climbing (escalar). Same word in ascend.confirm.

ascend.confirm.text: ¿Ascender ahora? Empezarás de cero, pero atraparás peces raros un {bonus}% más seguido.
ascend.confirm.note: start over -> empezar de cero; más seguido is the plain Latin American 'more often' (con más frecuencia is the stiffer alternative). No space before %.

weather.storm.text: ¡Se acerca una tormenta! Los peces raros están picando.
weather.storm.note: picar = fish taking the bait, the standard fishing sense.

quest.catch_n.text: Atrapa peces en la Bahía Lunar. Meta: {n}
quest.catch_n.note: n can be 1 and 'Atrapa 1 peces' is wrong, so the count follows a colon as in quest trackers. Moonlit Bay -> Bahía Lunar (moon-lit bay); Bahía Luz de Luna is a longer alternative. In-world signs that still say Moonlit Bay would no longer match.
quest.catch_n.review_reason: A bare count after a colon reads as progress as easily as the goal (the blind back-translator could not tell); 'Meta:' makes {n} the target and stays right for n = 1 (38/40).

friends.boost.text: Pescar con amigos te da +{percent}% de suerte
friends.boost.note: te added for natural second person; no space before %.

trade.sent.note: Solicitud de intercambio enviada a {player} is 35, over the 33 budget; pedir is the plain verb the guide prefers. Gender-neutral for {player}.

trade.accept.note: 'your trade request' shortened to tu intercambio; tu solicitud de intercambio would be 35, over 33. Verb only, so {player}'s gender never shows.

codes.enter.note: Ingresar is the Latin American UI verb for typing a code (Introducir is Spain).

codes.redeemed.note: Canjear is Roblox's own redeem verb.

afk.kicked.text: Estuviste AFK demasiado tiempo y dejaste de pescar.
afk.kicked.note: idle -> AFK, which the guide keeps and kids use; inactivo would put a masculine adjective on a player of unknown gender. Nothing about being kicked added.

daily.streak.text: ¡Día {day} de racha! Vuelve mañana por más recompensas.
daily.streak.note: Label form 'Racha: día {day}' works for day 1. 'for more' made concrete as recompensas, as the context says it means.
daily.streak.review_reason: A colon label inside an exclamation ('¡Racha: día 3!') reads stiff; '¡Día {day} de racha!' is the natural phrasing and is just as safe for day 1.

tip.night.text: Consejo: algunos peces solo pican de noche.
tip.night.note: Consejo: is the usual tip label; picar in the fishing sense.

group.join.text: ¡Únete a nuestra comunidad y gana 50 carnadas gratis!
group.join.note: Roblox now calls groups comunidades. 'the group' -> nuestra comunidad so it reads as the studio's own, as in the guide reference. Carnadas counted as units of bait.

leaderboard.biggest.note: Biggest = heaviest by weight per context, so pesado; Mayor captura would keep the size ambiguity.
